title: Meant
description: The meaning layer for contract calls: Candid interfaces compiled into a canonical, identity-addressed graph, and profiles that say what each value means and what each call does.

pages.title: What is Meant?
pages.lead: Two layers for one job: the interface says what a call's values are, the profile says what they mean.
